---
title: "Build v7.2 (`v7c`) — sea turtles and the North Atlantic right whale where the record places them"
params:
  ver: v7c
  ver_prev: v7
msens:
  target_name: build_v7c
  workflow_type: release
  dependency: [build_v7c_exclusions]
  output: data/manifests/build_v7c.json
editor_options:
  chunk_output_type: console
---

v7.2 is a **second surgical patch of the public v7 release** — same `usa05` grid, same
`mdl_seq`/`value` schema, same 20 Program Areas — built exactly as v7.1 (`build_v7b.qmd`) was: clone
v7's DuckDB copy-on-write, change only the merged models the rules touch under their EXISTING
`mdl_seq`, then re-execute v7's own scoring chunks verbatim. It supersedes v7.1 for review. Three
rules, nothing else:

1. **Turtle record rule.** A sea-turtle species is dropped from an ecoregion where it has **never
   been recorded** in any observational channel (NOAA Alaska sightings, strandings and bycatch
   1963–2020, OBIS, GBIF incl. iNaturalist, WDFW, STSSN). On v7 that is the East Bering Sea for
   loggerhead, green, leatherback and olive ridley; the Gulf of Alaska, where all four are recorded,
   keeps them at their v7 values. **v7.1's suitability threshold (P ≥ 0.5, floor-of-1 fill dropped)
   is NOT carried**: v7's turtle models are kept exactly as they are everywhere the record rule does
   not reach, because the threshold removed loggerhead, green and olive ridley from the Gulf of
   Alaska where all three have been recorded.
2. **Right whale Gulf rule.** The North Atlantic right whale (`mdl_seq` 54252) is dropped from the
   two Gulf of America ecoregions (EGOA, WCGOA), outside its range.
3. **Coverage floor κ = 5 %**, carried from v7.1 unchanged (`msens::coverage_sql()` /
   `coverage_floor()`): a Program-Area component whose scored cells cover < 5 % of the area is not
   reportable — no row, never a zero.

Rules 1 and 2 are one mechanism: a **taxon × ecoregion exclusion** read from the evidence table
`data/v7c/zone_exclusions.csv`, written and justified by `build_v7c_exclusions.qmd`, and applied by
`msens::zone_exclude_sql()`. A cell belongs to the ecoregion covering most of it
(`msens::cell_zone_major_sql()`), and **critical habitat is never excluded**: a cell the taxon holds
under a designated `ch_*` / `ca_*` dataset survives inside an excluded ecoregion. The notebook asserts
that the cells it removes per (model, ecoregion) are exactly the evidence table's `n_cells_v7`.

Each rule is a flag whose **control value is off**, so the same code path reproduces v7 exactly.
That is the first gate below, and it is what makes every other number here attributable.

Not in v7.2: productivity, the distribution-share / national score, anything of v10. **Every
`primprod*` row of v7c must equal v7's**, and a gate asserts it in every run.

## Design

```{mermaid}
%%| label: fig-design
%%| fig-cap: "v7 sdm.duckdb → copy-on-write clone → taxon × ecoregion exclusions under the SAME mdl_seq → v7's own scoring chunks → κ → v7c"
flowchart LR
  v7[("v7 sdm.duckdb<br/>read-only")] -->|cp -c| cl[("{ver} sdm.duckdb")]
  ev[["data/v7c/zone_exclusions.csv<br/>(build_v7c_exclusions)"]] --> ex
  cz["msens::cell_zone_major_sql<br/>majority ecoregion per cell"] --> ex
  ch["ch_src<br/>ch_* / ca_* cells per taxon"] --> ex
  ex["msens::zone_exclude_sql<br/>(mdl_seq, cell_id) to DELETE"] -->|"DELETE<br/>mdl_seq 54238-54243, 54252"| cl
  cl --> cz
  cl --> ch
  cl --> sc["v7 scoring chunks, verbatim<br/>(old/calc_scores_v7.qmd)"]
  sc --> k["msens::coverage_sql + coverage_floor<br/>kappa = 5%"]
  k --> sc2["composite score<br/>SUM(value)/COUNT(value)"]
  sc2 --> out[("v7c: model_cell, cell_metric,<br/>zone_metric, zone_taxon,<br/>release_method")]
```

## Setup

```{r}
#| label: setup

librarian::shelf(
  DBI, dbplyr, dplyr, duckdb, fs, glue, here, jsonlite, logger, purrr, readr,
  sf, stringr, tibble, tidyr,
  quiet = T)
options(readr.show_col_types = F)

ver      <- params$ver
ver_prev <- params$ver_prev

# paths come from msens::sdm_db_path(), never libs/paths.R (that file pins v9). The
# small per-release artifacts live under derived/{ver} (which IS big/{ver} on the
# laptop but NOT on the server), because backfill_versions.qmd reads layers_{ver}.csv
# from there.
is_server     <- Sys.info()[["sysname"]] == "Linux"
dir_derived   <- if (is_server) "/share/data/derived" else "~/_big/msens/derived"
sdm_db        <- path.expand(msens::sdm_db_path(ver))
sdm_db_prev   <- path.expand(msens::sdm_db_path(ver_prev))
dir_big_v     <- path_dir(sdm_db)
dir_v         <- path.expand(glue("{dir_derived}/{ver}"))
dir_v_prev    <- path.expand(glue("{dir_derived}/{ver_prev}"))
dir_scratch   <- path.expand(glue("{dir_big_v}/_controls"))
dir_create(c(dir_big_v, dir_v))

stopifnot(
  "previous release database not found"          = file_exists(sdm_db_prev),
  "previous release Program Area gpkg not found" =
    file_exists(glue("{dir_v_prev}/ply_programareas_2026_{ver_prev}.gpkg")),
  "msens 0.57.0 or newer is required (cell_zone_major_sql + zone_exclude_sql)" =
    packageVersion("msens") >= "0.57.0",
  "grid registry does not know this version"     = msens::grid_for_ver(ver) == "usa05")

# method flags -- CONTROL VALUE IS OFF for each, so all-off == v7 exactly ----
# EXCLUDE_TURTLES     : apply the turtle rows of the evidence table (0 = off)
# EXCLUDE_RIGHT_WHALE : apply the right-whale rows of the evidence table (0 = off)
# COVERAGE_FLOOR      : kappa, the reportability floor as a fraction (0 = off)
env_num <- function(key, default) {
  v <- trimws(Sys.getenv(key))
  if (!nzchar(v)) return(default)
  if (tolower(v) %in% c("na", "none", "")) return(NA_real_)
  as.numeric(v)
}
env_flag <- function(key, default) {
  v <- env_num(key, default)
  stopifnot("an on/off flag must be 0 or 1" = !is.na(v) && v %in% c(0, 1))
  v == 1
}
EXCLUDE_TURTLES     <- env_flag("EXCLUDE_TURTLES",     1)
EXCLUDE_RIGHT_WHALE <- env_flag("EXCLUDE_RIGHT_WHALE", 1)
COVERAGE_FLOOR      <- env_num ("COVERAGE_FLOOR",      0.05)
do_build            <- !file_exists(sdm_db) || nzchar(Sys.getenv("REDO_BUILD"))

# the merged models v7.2 may touch: v7's six sea turtles and the North Atlantic right whale
MDL_TURTLE_V7 <- 54238:54243
MDL_WHALE     <- 54252L
N_TURTLE_V7   <- 2022909      # v7's six merged turtle models, cells
N_WHALE_V7    <- 60690        # v7's merged right whale model, cells

# the evidence table: one row per excluded (model x ecoregion), written by build_v7c_exclusions ----
f_excl <- here("data/v7c/zone_exclusions.csv")
stopifnot("data/v7c/zone_exclusions.csv not found -- render build_v7c_exclusions.qmd first" =
  file_exists(f_excl))
d_excl <- read_csv(f_excl) |>
  mutate(mdl_seq = as.integer(mdl_seq), n_cells_v7 = as.integer(n_cells_v7))
stopifnot(
  "zone_exclusions.csv lacks a required column" =
    all(c("mdl_seq", "taxon_id", "common_name", "zone_fld", "zone_key", "n_cells_v7", "reason") %in%
          names(d_excl)),
  "zone_exclusions.csv is empty" = nrow(d_excl) > 0,
  "every exclusion is by ecoregion (decision 2: the ecoregion is the unit of exclusion)" =
    all(d_excl$zone_fld == "ecoregion_key"),
  "a (mdl_seq, zone_key) repeats in zone_exclusions.csv" =
    !anyDuplicated(d_excl[c("mdl_seq", "zone_key")]),
  "zone_exclusions.csv may only name v7's six merged turtles and the right whale" =
    all(d_excl$mdl_seq %in% c(MDL_TURTLE_V7, MDL_WHALE)),
  "every exclusion must remove at least one v7 cell" =
    all(!is.na(d_excl$n_cells_v7) & d_excl$n_cells_v7 > 0))
# decision 7: a turtle exclusion is exactly a zero-record row of the evidence
if ("n_records" %in% names(d_excl))
  stopifnot("a turtle exclusion has records in the evidence table -- the record rule drops only never-recorded pairs" =
    all(d_excl$n_records[d_excl$mdl_seq %in% MDL_TURTLE_V7] == 0))

N_TURTLE_EXCL <- sum(d_excl$n_cells_v7[d_excl$mdl_seq %in% MDL_TURTLE_V7])
N_WHALE_EXCL  <- sum(d_excl$n_cells_v7[d_excl$mdl_seq == MDL_WHALE])

# the exclusions as data, fingerprinted: release_method + the manifest carry it, so a release
# says which evidence table it applied
EXCL_HASH <- local({
  cc0 <- dbConnect(duckdb())
  on.exit(dbDisconnect(cc0, shutdown = TRUE))
  dbWriteTable(cc0, "excl", d_excl |> select(mdl_seq, zone_fld, zone_key, n_cells_v7))
  msens::hash_query(cc0, "SELECT mdl_seq, zone_fld, zone_key, n_cells_v7 FROM excl")
})

# size DuckDB to the machine, not to the laptop this was written on: duckdb_budget() /
# duckdb_tune() (40 % of available memory, <= 12 GB, threads <= cores; the why is in the file)
source(here("libs/duckdb_budget.R"))

f_gates <- file.path(dir_v, glue("tbl_gates_{ver}.csv"))
f_attr  <- file.path(dir_v, glue("tbl_attribution_programarea_{ver}.csv"))

msens::report_table(
  d_excl |> select(any_of(c("mdl_seq", "common_name", "zone_key", "n_cells_v7", "n_records", "reason"))),
  caption = glue("The evidence table applied (data/v7c/zone_exclusions.csv, hash {EXCL_HASH})"))

log_info(
  "{ver} <- {ver_prev}: turtles={EXCLUDE_TURTLES}, right_whale={EXCLUDE_RIGHT_WHALE}, ",
  "kappa={COVERAGE_FLOOR}; exclusions={nrow(d_excl)} rows / {EXCL_HASH}; build={do_build}; db={sdm_db}")
```

## The build

The whole patch is one function of `(flags, target dir)`, so the four control runs of
@sec-controls execute **the same code** on copy-on-write clones in a scratch directory. Nothing
here reads `libs/paths.R` and nothing writes to `{ver_prev}`: the previous release is opened
`read_only = TRUE` and never otherwise.

### v7's scoring chunks, read out of the archived notebook

v7 was never rendered from these notebooks — it is v6's database patched by `dev/build_v7.R`, which
**evals labelled chunks of the scoring notebook verbatim**. That technique is kept (it is the only
way to be bit-faithful to v7's arithmetic) but moved inside a committed, rendered notebook.

```{r}
#| label: chunk_reader

qmd_v7    <- here("old/calc_scores_v7.qmd")
qmd_lines <- readLines(qmd_v7)

get_chunk <- function(label) {
  lab <- grep(glue("^#\\|\\s*label:\\s*{label}\\s*$"), qmd_lines)
  stopifnot("chunk label not found exactly once in old/calc_scores_v7.qmd" = length(lab) == 1)
  open  <- max(grep("^```\\{", qmd_lines[seq_len(lab)]))
  close <- lab + grep("^```\\s*$", qmd_lines[(lab + 1):length(qmd_lines)])[1]
  code  <- qmd_lines[(open + 1):(close - 1)]
  paste(code[!grepl("^#\\|", code)], collapse = "\n")
}

# the two halves of v7's scoring, with kappa between them: the composite is
# SUM(value)/COUNT(value) over the component rows, so a not-reportable component must be
# gone BEFORE calc_programarea_score_from_programarea_metrics runs.
CHUNKS_PRE <- c(
  "calc_cell_metric_redlist", "calc_ecoregion_minmax",
  "extrisk_spcat_ecoregion_rescaled_cell", "cell_metrics_to_zone_metrics",
  "apply_pctarea_to_programarea_components")
CHUNKS_POST <- c(
  "cell_metrics_to_ecoregion_metrics", "cell_metric_score",
  "calc_programarea_score_from_programarea_metrics", "metric_labels",
  "add_full_studyarea_zone", "zone_taxon")

# `IUCN:TN` is a v1-v7 data artifact: an ESA "Threatened" code stamped with the IUCN
# authority, on 11 taxa (1 mammal -- the Arctic ringed seal -- and 10 birds). The msens that
# built v7 did not validate the code, so it fell through `score_iucn`'s `.default = 1L` and
# scored **1**; that is what `taxon.er_score` still stores for all 11. msens >= 0.19 ERRORS
# on it, which stops `calc_cell_metric_redlist` dead. Reproducing v7 means reproducing that
# 1 -- recoding those taxa is a data question, and it belongs to v10, not to a patch that
# must reproduce its predecessor exactly. The IUCN branch also ignores `is_mmpa` (the same
# documented quirk that made `IUCN:LC + MMPA` score 1); that too is v7's behavior and stays.
ER_LEGACY <- c("IUCN:TN" = 1L)
er_score_v7 <- function(extrisk_code, is_mmpa = FALSE, is_mbta = FALSE) {
  n   <- length(extrisk_code)
  out <- rep(NA_integer_, n)
  leg <- !is.na(extrisk_code) & extrisk_code %in% names(ER_LEGACY)
  if (any(leg))  out[leg]  <- unname(ER_LEGACY[extrisk_code[leg]])
  if (any(!leg)) out[!leg] <- msens::compute_er_score(
    extrisk_code[!leg],
    is_mmpa = rep_len(is_mmpa, n)[!leg],
    is_mbta = rep_len(is_mbta, n)[!leg])
  out
}

# dev/build_v7.R:87-88 widened zone_taxon from (subregions, program areas) to include
# ecoregions. The archived notebook already carries that edit, so the substitution is a
# no-op -- asserted rather than assumed, because a silent no-op would drop 45k rows.
chunk_fix <- function(code)
  gsub("msens::compute_er_score(", "er_score_v7(",
    gsub("c(tbl_sr, tbl_pra)", "c(tbl_sr, tbl_pra, tbl_er)", code, fixed = TRUE), fixed = TRUE)
zt_fix <- chunk_fix
stopifnot("zone_taxon chunk does not cover ecoregions" =
  grepl("c(tbl_sr, tbl_pra, tbl_er)", chunk_fix(get_chunk("zone_taxon")), fixed = TRUE),
  "the extinction-risk chunk no longer calls compute_er_score" =
  grepl("er_score_v7(", chunk_fix(get_chunk("calc_cell_metric_redlist")), fixed = TRUE))

# no primprod_* chunk is evaluated (the year-integrated productivity stays with v10), so
# those cell metrics remain v7's own rows.
stopifnot("a primprod chunk leaked into the run list" =
  !any(grepl("primprod", c(CHUNKS_PRE, CHUNKS_POST))))

# er_score_v7 may differ from msens ONLY on the legacy code, and only by not erroring
.codes <- c("NMFS:EN", "NMFS:TN", "NMFS:LC", "FWS:EN", "FWS:TN", "FWS:LC",
            "IUCN:CR", "IUCN:EN", "IUCN:VU", "IUCN:NT", "IUCN:LC", "IUCN:DD", NA)
stopifnot(
  "er_score_v7 diverges from msens::compute_er_score on a valid code" =
    identical(er_score_v7(.codes, is_mmpa = TRUE, is_mbta = TRUE),
              msens::compute_er_score(.codes, is_mmpa = TRUE, is_mbta = TRUE)),
  "the legacy IUCN:TN code must score 1, as it did for v1-v7" =
    identical(er_score_v7(c("IUCN:TN", "IUCN:LC"), is_mmpa = TRUE), c(1L, 1L)))
```

### Clone, exclusions, κ, `release_method`

```{r}
#| label: build_fns

# copy-on-write clone: APFS `cp -c` on the laptop, `cp --reflink=auto` on Linux. A 3.6 GB
# release database clones in milliseconds and only the pages the patch rewrites cost space.
clone_db <- function(src, dst) {
  if (file_exists(dst))               file_delete(dst)
  if (file_exists(glue("{dst}.wal"))) file_delete(glue("{dst}.wal"))
  dir_create(path_dir(dst))
  flag <- if (is_server) "--reflink=auto" else "-c"
  rc   <- system2("cp", c(flag, shQuote(src), shQuote(dst)))
  stopifnot("copy-on-write clone failed" = identical(as.integer(rc), 0L))
  log_info("cloned {src} -> {dst}")
}

# the record rule: DELETE the evidence table's (model x ecoregion) cells under the EXISTING
# merged ids. Re-merging would RENUMBER mdl_seq and break every published ?mdl_seq= deep link;
# a delete leaves every surviving cell at its v7 value, which is the point -- outside the
# excluded ecoregions the species is exactly v7's.
apply_exclusions <- function(con, excl, label) {
  if (!nrow(excl)) {
    log_info("[{label}] no exclusion applied -- the merged models stay v7's")
    return(invisible(tibble(mdl_seq = integer(), zone_key = character(),
                            n_cells_v7 = integer(), n_deleted = integer())))
  }
  seqs    <- sort(unique(excl$mdl_seq))
  seq_sql <- paste(seqs, collapse = ", ")
  stopifnot("an exclusion names a model outside v7's six turtles and the right whale" =
    all(seqs %in% c(MDL_TURTLE_V7, MDL_WHALE)))

  # each cell's ONE ecoregion: the one covering most of it (1,125 cells straddle two)
  dbExecute(con, glue(
    "CREATE OR REPLACE TEMP TABLE cell_zone AS {msens::cell_zone_major_sql('ecoregion_key')}"))

  # critical habitat is never excluded: the cells each excluded taxon carries under any
  # designation dataset (ch_* / ca_*), keyed by the taxon's MERGED mdl_seq. A table, not a
  # view: it reads model_cell, which the delete below changes.
  dbExecute(con, glue(
    "CREATE OR REPLACE TEMP TABLE ch_src AS
     SELECT DISTINCT t.mdl_seq, mc.cell_id
     FROM taxon t
     JOIN taxon_model tm ON tm.taxon_id = t.taxon_id
     JOIN model_cell  mc ON mc.mdl_seq  = tm.mdl_seq
     WHERE t.mdl_seq IN ({seq_sql})
       AND (tm.ds_key LIKE 'ch\\_%' ESCAPE '\\' OR tm.ds_key LIKE 'ca\\_%' ESCAPE '\\')"))

  # materialize the rows to delete, so the count per (model, ecoregion) is asserted against
  # the evidence table BEFORE anything is removed
  sql <- msens::zone_exclude_sql(
    excl |> select(mdl_seq, zone_key),
    src = "model_cell", cell_zone = "cell_zone", ch_src = "ch_src")
  dbExecute(con, glue("CREATE OR REPLACE TEMP TABLE excl_del AS {sql}"))

  d_n <- dbGetQuery(con,
    "SELECT d.mdl_seq, cz.zone_key, count(*) AS n_deleted
     FROM excl_del d JOIN cell_zone cz USING (cell_id) GROUP BY ALL")
  d_chk <- excl |>
    select(mdl_seq, zone_key, n_cells_v7) |>
    left_join(d_n |> mutate(mdl_seq = as.integer(mdl_seq)), by = c("mdl_seq", "zone_key")) |>
    mutate(n_deleted = coalesce(as.integer(n_deleted), 0L))
  stopifnot(
    "cells selected per (mdl_seq, ecoregion) must equal the evidence table's n_cells_v7 exactly" =
      all(d_chk$n_deleted == d_chk$n_cells_v7),
    "the exclusion selected cells outside the evidence table's (mdl_seq, ecoregion) pairs" =
      sum(d_n$n_deleted) == sum(d_chk$n_deleted))

  n <- dbExecute(con,
    "DELETE FROM model_cell WHERE (mdl_seq, cell_id) IN (SELECT mdl_seq, cell_id FROM excl_del)")
  stopifnot("DELETE removed a different number of rows than the exclusion selected" =
    n == sum(d_chk$n_cells_v7))

  # the rule, stated on the model it changed; idempotent (any previous v7.2 clause is stripped)
  d_z <- excl |> group_by(mdl_seq) |>
    summarize(zones = paste(sort(zone_key), collapse = ", "), .groups = "drop")
  for (i in seq_len(nrow(d_z)))
    dbExecute(con, glue(
      "UPDATE model SET description =
         regexp_replace(coalesce(description, ''), ' \\| v7\\.2 record rule.*$', '') ||
         ' | v7.2 record rule: excluded from {d_z$zones[i]}'
       WHERE mdl_seq = {d_z$mdl_seq[i]}"))

  log_info("[{label}] excluded {format(n, big.mark = ',')} cells: ",
           "{paste(glue('{d_chk$mdl_seq} x {d_chk$zone_key} = {d_chk$n_deleted}'), collapse = '; ')}")
  invisible(d_chk)
}

# kappa: a ZONE reporting rule. Cell-level rasters are untouched; only the Program-Area
# component row of a pair below the floor is deleted (its raw and _prepctareaweighting rows
# stay, so the diagnostic remains readable), and the composite then averages one fewer
# component -- exactly as it already does for an area with no turtles at all.
apply_kappa <- function(con, tbl_pra, component_keys, kappa, f_csv) {
  if (is.na(kappa) || kappa <= 0) {
    log_info("COVERAGE_FLOOR off -- no _coverage metrics written, no component dropped")
    return(invisible(NULL))
  }
  d <- dbGetQuery(con, msens::coverage_sql(
        tbl_pra, component_keys, weight = "pct_covered",
        val_col = msens::sdm_val_col(con, "cell_metric"))) |>
    msens::coverage_floor(kappa = kappa)

  z_seqs <- dbGetQuery(con, glue(
    "SELECT zone_seq FROM zone WHERE tbl = '{tbl_pra}'"))$zone_seq
  z_sql  <- paste(z_seqs, collapse = ", ")

  for (k in component_keys) {
    k_cov <- glue("{k}_coverage")
    if (!nrow(dbGetQuery(con, glue("SELECT 1 FROM metric WHERE metric_key = '{k_cov}'"))))
      dbExecute(con, glue(
        "INSERT INTO metric (metric_key, description) VALUES
         ('{k_cov}', 'Percent of the zone covered by cells carrying {k} (coverage floor input)')"))
    s_cov <- dbGetQuery(con, glue(
      "SELECT metric_seq FROM metric WHERE metric_key = '{k_cov}'"))$metric_seq
    dbExecute(con, glue(
      "DELETE FROM zone_metric WHERE metric_seq = {s_cov} AND zone_seq IN ({z_sql})"))
    dd <- d |> filter(metric_key == k)
    if (nrow(dd))
      dbExecute(con, glue(
        "INSERT INTO zone_metric (zone_seq, metric_seq, value) VALUES {vals}",
        vals = paste(glue("({dd$zone_seq}, {s_cov}, {dd$coverage * 100})"), collapse = ", ")))
  }

  d_drop <- d |> filter(!reportable)
  for (i in seq_len(nrow(d_drop)))
    dbExecute(con, glue(
      "DELETE FROM zone_metric
       WHERE zone_seq = {d_drop$zone_seq[i]}
         AND metric_seq = (SELECT metric_seq FROM metric WHERE metric_key = '{d_drop$metric_key[i]}')"))

  d_out <- d |>
    left_join(dbGetQuery(con, glue(
      "SELECT zone_seq, value AS programarea_key FROM zone WHERE tbl = '{tbl_pra}'")),
      by = "zone_seq") |>
    arrange(coverage) |>
    select(programarea_key, metric_key, coverage, reportable)
  write_csv(d_out |> filter(!reportable), f_csv)
  log_info("kappa={kappa}: {nrow(d_drop)} of {nrow(d)} (zone x component) pairs not reportable")
  invisible(d_out)
}

# the methods a release actually used, as data -- backfill_versions.qmd stages this table and
# manifest_build() carries it as `methods`, so the docs state the rules from the release itself
write_release_method <- function(con, ex_turtles, ex_whale, kappa) {
  onoff <- function(x) if (isTRUE(x)) "on" else "off"
  d <- tibble(
    method_key  = c("turtle_record_rule", "right_whale_gulf_rule", "coverage_floor_pct",
                    "zone_exclusions_hash", "prev"),
    value       = c(
      onoff(ex_turtles),
      onoff(ex_whale),
      as.character(if (is.na(kappa)) 0 else kappa * 100),
      EXCL_HASH,
      ver_prev),
    description = c(
      "A sea-turtle species is dropped from an ecoregion where it has never been recorded in any observational channel; critical habitat is never dropped (v7: off)",
      "The North Atlantic right whale is dropped from the Gulf of America ecoregions (EGOA, WCGOA), outside its range; critical habitat is never dropped (v7: off)",
      "A Program-Area component is reportable only if its scored cells cover at least this percent of the area (v7: 0)",
      "msens::hash_query digest of data/v7c/zone_exclusions.csv (mdl_seq, zone_fld, zone_key, n_cells_v7), the evidence table the record rules apply",
      "The release this one patches"))
  dbWriteTable(con, "release_method", d, overwrite = TRUE)
  d
}
```

### One function, five runs

```{r}
#| label: build_release

build_release <- function(db_path, out_dir, ex_turtles, ex_whale, kappa, label) {
  t0 <- Sys.time()
  dir_create(out_dir)
  clone_db(sdm_db_prev, db_path)

  con <- dbConnect(duckdb(dbdir = db_path, read_only = FALSE))
  # v7's zone / metric / model / dataset tables carry `DEFAULT CURRENT_DATE`, which DuckDB binds
  # to the icu extension -- so EVERY write to them needs it, the zone-table rename included.
  # A laptop autoloads icu from ~/.duckdb; the server's rstudio container has no copy for
  # uid 1000 and halted here on its first UPDATE. Declared, as the other notebooks declare httpfs.
  dbExecute(con, "INSTALL icu; LOAD icu;")
  on.exit(dbDisconnect(con, shutdown = TRUE), add = TRUE)
  duckdb_tune(con, glue("{out_dir}/duckdb_tmp"))

  # the server's clone inherits a cell_model VIEW whose read_parquet path is absolute and
  # points at {ver_prev}: left in place it would serve the PREVIOUS release's cells under
  # this release's name. Dropped, then asserted gone.
  dbExecute(con, "DROP VIEW IF EXISTS cell_model")
  v_bad <- dbGetQuery(con, glue(
    "SELECT view_name FROM duckdb_views() WHERE sql LIKE '%/{ver_prev}/%'"))
  stopifnot("a view still references the previous release's path" = nrow(v_bad) == 0)

  # zone tbl suffix _v7 -> _v7c (dev/build_v7.R:55-61)
  for (old_tbl in dbGetQuery(con, glue(
      "SELECT DISTINCT tbl FROM zone WHERE tbl LIKE '%\\_{ver_prev}' ESCAPE '\\'"))$tbl) {
    new_tbl <- str_replace(old_tbl, glue("_{ver_prev}$"), glue("_{ver}"))
    dbExecute(con, glue("UPDATE zone       SET tbl = '{new_tbl}'      WHERE tbl = '{old_tbl}'"))
    dbExecute(con, glue("UPDATE zone_taxon SET zone_tbl = '{new_tbl}' WHERE zone_tbl = '{old_tbl}'"))
    log_info("renamed zone tbl: {old_tbl} -> {new_tbl}")
  }

  # the ids the rules may touch, asserted on the clone: the merged ids never move
  seq_turtle <- dbGetQuery(con,
    "SELECT mdl_seq FROM taxon WHERE sp_cat = 'turtle' ORDER BY mdl_seq")$mdl_seq
  d_whale <- dbGetQuery(con, glue(
    "SELECT sp_cat, common_name FROM taxon WHERE mdl_seq = {MDL_WHALE}"))
  stopifnot(
    "expected v7's six merged turtle models at 54238-54243" =
      identical(as.integer(seq_turtle), MDL_TURTLE_V7),
    "expected v7's merged North Atlantic right whale at mdl_seq 54252" =
      nrow(d_whale) == 1 && d_whale$sp_cat == "mammal" &&
        d_whale$common_name == "North Atlantic Right Whale")

  # split the evidence table by flag: turtle rows = the turtle taxa's merged ids, whale rows = 54252
  excl <- bind_rows(
    d_excl |> filter(ex_turtles, mdl_seq %in% seq_turtle),
    d_excl |> filter(ex_whale,   mdl_seq == MDL_WHALE))
  d_ex <- apply_exclusions(con, excl, label)

  # v7's scoring chunks need these names; a child of globalenv() keeps the chunk code's own
  # assignments out of the session while still resolving library functions
  env <- new.env(parent = globalenv())
  env$con_sdm <- con
  env$tbl_pra <- glue("ply_programareas_2026_{ver}")
  env$tbl_sr  <- glue("ply_subregions_2026_{ver}")
  env$tbl_er  <- "ply_ecoregions_2025"
  env$component_pct_pra_csv <- file.path(out_dir, glue("tbl_component_pct_programarea_{ver}.csv"))
  env$zone_taxon_csv        <- file.path(out_dir, glue("zone_taxon_{ver}.csv"))
  # NEVER narrow sp_cats: the pct-area and composite chunks enumerate every component from it
  env$sp_cats <- dbGetQuery(con,
    "SELECT DISTINCT sp_cat FROM taxon WHERE is_ok ORDER BY sp_cat")$sp_cat
  stopifnot("sp_cats lost a category" = length(env$sp_cats) == 7)

  run <- function(labels)
    for (lbl in labels) {
      log_info("[{label}] chunk: {lbl}")
      eval(parse(text = chunk_fix(get_chunk(lbl))), envir = env)
    }

  run(CHUNKS_PRE)
  d_cov <- apply_kappa(
    con, env$tbl_pra,
    c(glue("extrisk_{env$sp_cats}_ecoregion_rescaled"), "primprod_ecoregion_rescaled"),
    kappa, file.path(out_dir, glue("tbl_component_not_reportable_programarea_{ver}.csv")))
  run(CHUNKS_POST)

  write_release_method(con, ex_turtles, ex_whale, kappa)

  log_info("[{label}] built in {round(as.numeric(difftime(Sys.time(), t0, units = 'mins')), 1)} min")
  invisible(list(excl = d_ex, coverage = d_cov))
}
```

## Build `v7c`

```{r}
#| label: build

if (!do_build) {
  log_info("{sdm_db} exists -- rendering report + gates read-only (REDO_BUILD=1 to rebuild)")
} else {
  build_release(sdm_db, dir_v, EXCLUDE_TURTLES, EXCLUDE_RIGHT_WHALE, COVERAGE_FLOOR, ver)
}
stopifnot("release database missing after build" = file_exists(sdm_db))

con <- dbConnect(duckdb(dbdir = sdm_db, read_only = TRUE))
duckdb_tune(con, glue("{dir_big_v}/duckdb_tmp"))
dbExecute(con, glue("ATTACH '{sdm_db_prev}' AS prev (READ_ONLY)"))

tbl_pra <- glue("ply_programareas_2026_{ver}")
tbl_sr  <- glue("ply_subregions_2026_{ver}")
tbl_er  <- "ply_ecoregions_2025"
sp_cats <- dbGetQuery(con, "SELECT DISTINCT sp_cat FROM taxon WHERE is_ok ORDER BY sp_cat")$sp_cat
MDL_TURTLE <- dbGetQuery(con, "SELECT mdl_seq FROM taxon WHERE sp_cat = 'turtle' ORDER BY mdl_seq")$mdl_seq
mdl_sql     <- paste(MDL_TURTLE, collapse = ", ")
mdl_all_sql <- paste(c(MDL_TURTLE, MDL_WHALE), collapse = ", ")
K_SCORE <- "score_extriskspcat_primprod_ecoregionrescaled_equalweights"

# the evidence table's own v7 numbers, checked against v7 itself
n_prev <- dbGetQuery(con, glue(
  "SELECT count(*) FILTER (WHERE mdl_seq IN ({mdl_sql})) AS n_turtle,
          count(*) FILTER (WHERE mdl_seq = {MDL_WHALE})  AS n_whale
   FROM prev.model_cell WHERE mdl_seq IN ({mdl_all_sql})"))
stopifnot(
  "v7's six turtle models are not 2,022,909 cells" = n_prev$n_turtle == N_TURTLE_V7,
  "v7's right whale model is not 60,690 cells"     = n_prev$n_whale  == N_WHALE_V7)

# each cell's majority ecoregion, for the gates and the report (the zone geometry is v7's)
dbExecute(con, glue(
  "CREATE OR REPLACE TEMP TABLE cell_zone AS {msens::cell_zone_major_sql('ecoregion_key')}"))
```

## Artifacts {#sec-artifacts}

`layers_{ver}.csv`, the pct-area diagnostic and `zone_taxon_{ver}.csv` are written by the build
itself; the Program-Area geopackage is **regenerated** (v7's own gpkg is md5-identical to v6's — it
was copied, so its metric columns are stale) from the previous release's geometry columns plus this
release's `zone_metric` pivoted wide, per `old/calc_scores_v7.qmd:2893-2940`.

```{r}
#| label: artifacts

f_lyrs <- file.path(dir_v, glue("layers_{ver}.csv"))
f_gpkg <- file.path(dir_v, glue("ply_programareas_2026_{ver}.gpkg"))
f_srpa <- file.path(dir_v, "subregion_programareas.csv")

if (do_build || !file_exists(f_lyrs))
  bind_rows(
    tibble(order = 1, category = "Overall",
           layer = "score", lyr = K_SCORE),
    tibble(order = 2, category = "Species, rescaled by Ecoregion",
           layer = glue("{sp_cats}: ext. risk, ecorgn"),
           lyr   = glue("extrisk_{sp_cats}_ecoregion_rescaled")),
    tibble(order = 3, category = "Primary Productivity, rescaled by Ecoregion",
           layer = "prim prod, ecorgn", lyr = "primprod_ecoregion_rescaled"),
    tibble(order = 4, category = "Species, raw Extinction Risk",
           layer = glue("{sp_cats}: ext. risk"), lyr = glue("extrisk_{sp_cats}")),
    tibble(order = 5, category = "Primary Productivity, raw Phytoplankton",
           lyr = "primprod", layer = "prim prod, 2014-2023 avg (mg C/m^2/day)")) |>
    write_csv(f_lyrs)

# version-independent lookup: carried forward, not recomputed
if (!file_exists(f_srpa))
  file_copy(file.path(dir_v_prev, "subregion_programareas.csv"), f_srpa)

if (do_build || !file_exists(f_gpkg)) {
  d_pra_metrics <- dbGetQuery(con, glue(
    "SELECT z.value AS programarea_key, m.metric_key, round(zm.value, 1) AS value
     FROM zone z JOIN zone_metric zm USING (zone_seq) JOIN metric m USING (metric_seq)
     WHERE z.tbl = '{tbl_pra}' AND zm.value IS NOT NULL")) |>
    pivot_wider(names_from = metric_key, values_from = value)
  base_cols <- c("programarea_id", "region_key", "region_name", "planarea_key", "planarea_name",
                 "programarea_key", "programarea_name", "ctr_lon", "ctr_lat", "area_km2")
  read_sf(file.path(dir_v_prev, glue("ply_programareas_2026_{ver_prev}.gpkg"))) |>
    select(any_of(base_cols)) |>
    left_join(d_pra_metrics, by = "programarea_key") |>
    st_write(f_gpkg, delete_dsn = TRUE, quiet = TRUE)
}

f_art <- c(f_lyrs, f_gpkg, f_srpa,
           file.path(dir_v, glue("tbl_component_pct_programarea_{ver}.csv")),
           file.path(dir_v, glue("zone_taxon_{ver}.csv")))
msens::report_table(
  tibble(file = basename(f_art), exists = file_exists(f_art),
         kb = round(as.numeric(file_size(f_art)) / 1024)),
  caption = glue("Artifacts in {dir_v}"))
```

## Comparing a build against v7 {#sec-compare}

One function, used for `v7c` and for each control. It compares the touched merged models and the
three surfaces that carry the release — `cell_metric` (~22.0 M rows), `zone_metric` and
`zone_taxon` — **by key, exactly**, and reports the largest value movement per metric.

A note on "exactly". `model_cell.value` is INTEGER, so the six turtle models and the right whale are
compared bit-for-bit and the only admissible answers are 0 diffs (flag off) or exactly the evidence
table's cells (flag on). The scored surfaces are DOUBLE and every zone value is a `SUM()` over up to
662,075 cells: IEEE addition is not associative, and DuckDB's parallel aggregate does not fix the
reduction order, so re-running v7's own SQL on v7's own data reproduces `zone_metric` to about 5 ULP
(measured: max 8.9e-15 on values near 10) rather than bit-identically. The gate is therefore
**exact on keys** (no row gained, none lost, none renamed) and **bounded on values at 1e-9
relative** — four orders of magnitude tighter than the smallest change either method makes, and six
orders looser than reassociation noise. `n_moved` below counts values outside that bound; it is the
number the gates assert.

```{r}
#| label: compare_fn

# rel difference guard: |a-b| / max(|b|, 1) -- absolute for small values, relative for large
REL_TOL <- 1e-9

# an INTEGER model surface vs v7's: exact multiset difference, both directions
surface_cmp <- function(cc, ms) dbGetQuery(cc, glue(
  "SELECT
     (SELECT count(*) FROM (SELECT mdl_seq, cell_id, value FROM model_cell WHERE mdl_seq IN ({ms})
        EXCEPT ALL SELECT mdl_seq, cell_id, value FROM prev.model_cell WHERE mdl_seq IN ({ms}))) AS new_not_prev,
     (SELECT count(*) FROM (SELECT mdl_seq, cell_id, value FROM prev.model_cell WHERE mdl_seq IN ({ms})
        EXCEPT ALL SELECT mdl_seq, cell_id, value FROM model_cell WHERE mdl_seq IN ({ms}))) AS prev_not_new,
     (SELECT count(*) FROM model_cell      WHERE mdl_seq IN ({ms})) AS n_new,
     (SELECT count(*) FROM prev.model_cell WHERE mdl_seq IN ({ms})) AS n_prev,
     (SELECT count(*) FROM (SELECT mdl_seq, cell_id FROM model_cell WHERE mdl_seq IN ({ms})
        EXCEPT SELECT mdl_seq, cell_id FROM prev.model_cell WHERE mdl_seq IN ({ms}))) AS n_gained"))

compare_build <- function(db_path) {
  cc <- dbConnect(duckdb(dbdir = db_path, read_only = TRUE))
  on.exit(dbDisconnect(cc, shutdown = TRUE), add = TRUE)
  duckdb_tune(cc, glue("{path_dir(db_path)}/duckdb_tmp"))
  # ATTACH is per DATABASE INSTANCE, not per connection: comparing the release this notebook
  # already holds open would otherwise fail with `database with name "prev" already exists`.
  if (!nrow(dbGetQuery(cc, "SELECT 1 FROM duckdb_databases() WHERE database_name = 'prev'")))
    dbExecute(cc, glue("ATTACH '{sdm_db_prev}' AS prev (READ_ONLY)"))

  turtle <- surface_cmp(cc, paste(MDL_TURTLE, collapse = ", "))
  whale  <- surface_cmp(cc, MDL_WHALE)

  cell <- dbGetQuery(cc, glue(
    "WITH a AS (SELECT m.metric_key AS k, cm.cell_id AS cid, cm.value AS v
                FROM cell_metric cm JOIN metric m USING (metric_seq)),
          b AS (SELECT m.metric_key AS k, cm.cell_id AS cid, cm.value AS v
                FROM prev.cell_metric cm JOIN prev.metric m USING (metric_seq)),
          j AS (SELECT coalesce(a.k, b.k) AS metric_key, a.v AS va, b.v AS vb
                FROM a FULL JOIN b ON a.k = b.k AND a.cid = b.cid)
     SELECT metric_key,
            count(*) FILTER (WHERE vb IS NULL) AS n_only_new,
            count(*) FILTER (WHERE va IS NULL) AS n_only_prev,
            coalesce(max(abs(va - vb) / greatest(abs(vb), 1.0)), 0) AS max_rel,
            count(*) FILTER (WHERE abs(va - vb) / greatest(abs(vb), 1.0) > {REL_TOL}) AS n_moved
     FROM j GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1"))

  zone <- dbGetQuery(cc, glue(
    "WITH a AS (SELECT z.fld AS f, z.value AS zv, m.metric_key AS k, zm.value AS v
                FROM zone_metric zm JOIN zone z USING (zone_seq) JOIN metric m USING (metric_seq)),
          b AS (SELECT z.fld AS f, z.value AS zv, m.metric_key AS k, zm.value AS v
                FROM prev.zone_metric zm JOIN prev.zone z USING (zone_seq)
                JOIN prev.metric m USING (metric_seq)),
          j AS (SELECT coalesce(a.k, b.k) AS metric_key, a.v AS va, b.v AS vb
                FROM a FULL JOIN b ON a.f = b.f AND a.zv = b.zv AND a.k = b.k)
     SELECT metric_key,
            count(*) FILTER (WHERE vb IS NULL) AS n_only_new,
            count(*) FILTER (WHERE va IS NULL) AS n_only_prev,
            coalesce(max(abs(va - vb) / greatest(abs(vb), 1.0)), 0) AS max_rel,
            count(*) FILTER (WHERE abs(va - vb) / greatest(abs(vb), 1.0) > {REL_TOL}) AS n_moved
     FROM j GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1"))

  # zone_taxon: key = (zone_fld, zone_value, mdl_seq); zone_tbl differs by the _v7c rename
  ztx <- dbGetQuery(cc, glue(
    "WITH a AS (SELECT zone_fld f, zone_value zv, mdl_seq, sp_cat, area_km2, avg_suit,
                       suit_rl, suit_rl_area, cat_suit_rl_area, pct_cat FROM zone_taxon),
          b AS (SELECT zone_fld f, zone_value zv, mdl_seq, sp_cat, area_km2, avg_suit,
                       suit_rl, suit_rl_area, cat_suit_rl_area, pct_cat FROM prev.zone_taxon),
          j AS (SELECT coalesce(a.sp_cat, b.sp_cat) AS sp_cat,
                       a.area_km2 aa, b.area_km2 ba, a.avg_suit sa, b.avg_suit sb,
                       a.suit_rl ra, b.suit_rl rb, a.pct_cat pa, b.pct_cat pb,
                       a.f AS af, b.f AS bf
                FROM a FULL JOIN b ON a.f = b.f AND a.zv = b.zv AND a.mdl_seq = b.mdl_seq)
     -- named `metric_key` so moved_keys() reads the real column: it looked for metric_key,
     -- found nothing on a frame keyed by sp_cat, and the zone_taxon gate passed vacuously
     SELECT sp_cat AS metric_key,
            count(*) FILTER (WHERE bf IS NULL) AS n_only_new,
            count(*) FILTER (WHERE af IS NULL) AS n_only_prev,
            coalesce(greatest(
              max(abs(aa - ba) / greatest(abs(ba), 1.0)),
              max(abs(sa - sb) / greatest(abs(sb), 1.0)),
              max(abs(ra - rb) / greatest(abs(rb), 1.0)),
              max(abs(pa - pb) / greatest(abs(pb), 1.0))), 0) AS max_rel,
            count(*) FILTER (WHERE
              greatest(abs(aa - ba) / greatest(abs(ba), 1.0),
                       abs(sa - sb) / greatest(abs(sb), 1.0),
                       abs(ra - rb) / greatest(abs(rb), 1.0),
                       abs(pa - pb) / greatest(abs(pb), 1.0)) > {REL_TOL}) AS n_moved
     FROM j GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1"))

  pra <- dbGetQuery(cc, glue(
    "SELECT z.value AS programarea_key, m.metric_key, zm.value
     FROM zone_metric zm JOIN zone z USING (zone_seq) JOIN metric m USING (metric_seq)
     WHERE z.fld = 'programarea_key'"))

  list(turtle = turtle, whale = whale, cell = cell, zone = zone, ztx = ztx, pra = pra)
}

# the invariant that must hold in EVERY run, whatever the flags: the productivity fix is
# v10's. `{key}_coverage` is a NEW zone-only key, not a primprod row -- it says how much of
# the zone the component covers and never touches primprod's values.
moved_keys <- function(d) {
  # a check that reads a column that is not there returns character(0) and passes forever
  stopifnot("comparison frame has no metric_key column" = "metric_key" %in% names(d))
  sort(d$metric_key[d$n_moved > 0 | d$n_only_new > 0 | d$n_only_prev > 0])
}
primprod_ok <- function(cmp) {
  k <- c(moved_keys(cmp$cell), moved_keys(cmp$zone))
  !any(grepl("^primprod", k) & !grepl("_coverage$", k))
}
```

## Control runs {#sec-controls}

Four clones in a scratch directory, each through `build_release()` with a different flag set, then
deleted. The point of the all-off run is that it is the *same code path* as `v7c`: if it reproduces
v7, every difference `v7c` shows is attributable to a flag and nothing else.

```{r}
#| label: controls

CONTROLS <- tribble(
  ~run,           ~turtles, ~whale, ~kappa,
  "all_off",         FALSE,  FALSE, 0,
  "turtles_only",     TRUE,  FALSE, 0,
  "whale_only",      FALSE,   TRUE, 0,
  "kappa_only",      FALSE,  FALSE, COVERAGE_FLOOR)

do_controls <- do_build || !file_exists(f_gates)

if (!do_controls) {
  log_info("control gate results cached at {f_gates} -- not rebuilding the clones")
  # an EMPTY moved-key set is the passing answer, and read_csv() reads "" back as NA:
  # nchar(NA) == 0 is NA, so every gate below would halt on a cached re-render of a good build
  d_gates <- read_csv(f_gates) |>
    mutate(across(ends_with("_moved"), \(x) coalesce(as.character(x), "")))
  d_attr  <- read_csv(f_attr)
} else {
  cmps <- list()
  pras <- list()
  for (i in seq_len(nrow(CONTROLS))) {
    r  <- CONTROLS[i, ]
    od <- file.path(dir_scratch, r$run)
    build_release(file.path(od, "sdm.duckdb"), od, r$turtles, r$whale, r$kappa, r$run)
    cmps[[r$run]] <- compare_build(file.path(od, "sdm.duckdb"))
    pras[[r$run]] <- cmps[[r$run]]$pra
  }
  cmps[[ver]] <- compare_build(sdm_db)
  pras[[ver]] <- cmps[[ver]]$pra

  # one tidy row per (run, check) so the gates and a cached re-render assert the same numbers
  d_gates <- imap_dfr(cmps, function(cmp, run) tibble(
    run           = run,
    turtle_n      = cmp$turtle$n_new,
    turtle_gained = cmp$turtle$n_gained,
    turtle_diff   = cmp$turtle$new_not_prev + cmp$turtle$prev_not_new,
    whale_n       = cmp$whale$n_new,
    whale_gained  = cmp$whale$n_gained,
    whale_diff    = cmp$whale$new_not_prev + cmp$whale$prev_not_new,
    cell_moved    = paste(moved_keys(cmp$cell),  collapse = " "),
    zone_moved    = paste(moved_keys(cmp$zone),  collapse = " "),
    ztx_moved     = paste(moved_keys(cmp$ztx),   collapse = " "),
    cell_max_rel  = max(cmp$cell$max_rel), zone_max_rel = max(cmp$zone$max_rel),
    ztx_max_rel   = max(cmp$ztx$max_rel),
    primprod_ok   = primprod_ok(cmp)))
  write_csv(d_gates, f_gates)

  K_ATTR <- c(turtle    = "extrisk_turtle_ecoregion_rescaled",
              mammal    = "extrisk_mammal_ecoregion_rescaled",
              composite = K_SCORE)
  what_of <- function(k) names(K_ATTR)[match(k, K_ATTR)]
  d_attr <- imap_dfr(pras, \(d, run) d |> mutate(run = run)) |>
    filter(metric_key %in% K_ATTR) |>
    mutate(what = what_of(metric_key)) |>
    select(programarea_key, what, run, value) |>
    bind_rows(
      dbGetQuery(con, glue(
        "SELECT z.value AS programarea_key, m.metric_key, zm.value
         FROM prev.zone_metric zm JOIN prev.zone z USING (zone_seq)
         JOIN prev.metric m USING (metric_seq)
         WHERE z.fld = 'programarea_key'")) |>
        filter(metric_key %in% K_ATTR) |>
        mutate(what = what_of(metric_key), run = ver_prev) |>
        select(programarea_key, what, run, value))
  write_csv(d_attr, f_attr)

  dir_delete(dir_scratch)
  log_info("control clones removed from {dir_scratch}")
}

msens::report_table(
  d_gates |> select(run, turtle_n, turtle_gained, turtle_diff, whale_n, whale_gained, whale_diff,
                    primprod_ok, cell_max_rel, zone_max_rel, ztx_max_rel),
  caption = "Control runs vs v7 (turtle_diff / whale_diff are exact INTEGER multiset differences)")
```

## Gates that stop the line

```{r}
#| label: gate_all_off

g <- d_gates |> filter(run == "all_off")
stopifnot(
  "all flags off: the six turtle models must be v7's 2,022,909 cells, bit-identical" =
    g$turtle_n == N_TURTLE_V7 && g$turtle_diff == 0,
  "all flags off: the right whale model must be v7's 60,690 cells, bit-identical" =
    g$whale_n == N_WHALE_V7 && g$whale_diff == 0,
  "all flags off: cell_metric must not gain, lose or move a (metric_key, cell_id) value" =
    nchar(g$cell_moved) == 0,
  "all flags off: zone_metric must not gain, lose or move a (zone, metric_key) value" =
    nchar(g$zone_moved) == 0,
  "all flags off: zone_taxon must not gain, lose or move a row" =
    nchar(g$ztx_moved) == 0)
log_info("GATE all-off == v7: turtles {g$turtle_n} cells / {g$turtle_diff} diffs; right whale ",
         "{g$whale_n} cells / {g$whale_diff} diffs; max rel dev cell {signif(g$cell_max_rel, 3)}, ",
         "zone {signif(g$zone_max_rel, 3)}, zone_taxon {signif(g$ztx_max_rel, 3)} (tol {REL_TOL})")
```

```{r}
#| label: gate_single_flags

# each flag may move only its own component, the composite that averages it, and its own
# zone_taxon rows -- and must remove EXACTLY the evidence table's cells, no more, no fewer.
# kappa may move only the ONE pair it drops on v7 (St. George Basin turtles, 1.5 % coverage),
# the composite that no longer averages it, and the new _coverage keys -- and no cell metric
# at all, because it is a zone reporting rule. Naming the admissible keys rather than allowing
# any component is the point: if a second pair falls below the floor, that is news, not noise.
keys_of   <- function(x) setdiff(strsplit(coalesce(x, ""), " ")[[1]], "")
ok_turtle <- function(keys) all(grepl("^extrisk_turtle|^score_", keys))
ok_mammal <- function(keys) all(grepl("^extrisk_mammal|^score_", keys))
ok_kappa  <- function(keys) all(
  keys %in% c("extrisk_turtle_ecoregion_rescaled", K_SCORE) | grepl("_coverage$", keys))

gt <- d_gates |> filter(run == "turtles_only")
gw <- d_gates |> filter(run == "whale_only")
gk <- d_gates |> filter(run == "kappa_only")

stopifnot(
  "turtles-only: only extrisk_turtle* and the score may move in cell_metric" =
    ok_turtle(keys_of(gt$cell_moved)),
  "turtles-only: only extrisk_turtle* and the score may move in zone_metric" =
    ok_turtle(keys_of(gt$zone_moved)),
  "turtles-only: only turtle rows may move in zone_taxon" =
    all(keys_of(gt$ztx_moved) %in% "turtle"),
  "turtles-only: the turtle models must lose exactly the evidence table's cells and gain none" =
    gt$turtle_n == N_TURTLE_V7 - N_TURTLE_EXCL && gt$turtle_diff == N_TURTLE_EXCL &&
      gt$turtle_gained == 0,
  "turtles-only: the right whale must stay v7's" =
    gt$whale_n == N_WHALE_V7 && gt$whale_diff == 0,

  "whale-only: only extrisk_mammal* and the score may move in cell_metric" =
    ok_mammal(keys_of(gw$cell_moved)),
  "whale-only: only extrisk_mammal* and the score may move in zone_metric" =
    ok_mammal(keys_of(gw$zone_moved)),
  "whale-only: only mammal rows may move in zone_taxon" =
    all(keys_of(gw$ztx_moved) %in% "mammal"),
  "whale-only: the right whale must lose exactly the evidence table's cells and gain none" =
    gw$whale_n == N_WHALE_V7 - N_WHALE_EXCL && gw$whale_diff == N_WHALE_EXCL &&
      gw$whale_gained == 0,
  "whale-only: the turtle models must stay v7's" =
    gw$turtle_n == N_TURTLE_V7 && gw$turtle_diff == 0,

  "kappa-only: no cell metric may move -- kappa is a zone reporting rule" =
    nchar(gk$cell_moved) == 0,
  "kappa-only: zone_taxon must not move" =
    nchar(gk$ztx_moved) == 0,
  "kappa-only: only the dropped component, the score and the new _coverage keys may move" =
    ok_kappa(keys_of(gk$zone_moved)),
  "kappa-only: the turtle and right whale models must stay v7's" =
    gk$turtle_diff == 0 && gk$turtle_n == N_TURTLE_V7 &&
      gk$whale_diff == 0 && gk$whale_n == N_WHALE_V7)
log_info("GATE single flags: turtles-only moved cell[{gt$cell_moved}] zone[{gt$zone_moved}] ",
         "ztx[{gt$ztx_moved}], -{gt$turtle_diff} turtle cells; whale-only moved ",
         "cell[{gw$cell_moved}] zone[{gw$zone_moved}] ztx[{gw$ztx_moved}], -{gw$whale_diff} ",
         "right whale cells; kappa-only moved zone[{gk$zone_moved}]")
```

#| label: gate_primprod

# the productivity fix is NOT in v7.2. Every primprod row, cell and zone, must equal v7's in
# EVERY run -- the control runs included.
stopifnot("a primprod row moved in some run -- the productivity fix is v10's, not v7.2's" =
  all(d_gates$primprod_ok))
log_info("GATE primprod unchanged in all {nrow(d_gates)} runs")

```{r}
#| label: gate_surface

# the release itself: exactly the flagged exclusions, nothing gained, only admissible keys
gv  <- d_gates |> filter(run == ver)
n_t <- if (EXCLUDE_TURTLES)     N_TURTLE_EXCL else 0
n_w <- if (EXCLUDE_RIGHT_WHALE) N_WHALE_EXCL  else 0
ok_release <- function(keys) all(grepl("^extrisk_turtle|^extrisk_mammal|^score_|_coverage$", keys))

# critical habitat: every v7 cell a ch_* / ca_* dataset gives these taxa survives at its v7 value
n_ch <- dbGetQuery(con, glue(
  "WITH ch AS (
     SELECT DISTINCT t.mdl_seq, mc.cell_id
     FROM prev.taxon t
     JOIN prev.taxon_model tm ON tm.taxon_id = t.taxon_id
     JOIN prev.model_cell  mc ON mc.mdl_seq  = tm.mdl_seq
     WHERE t.mdl_seq IN ({mdl_all_sql})
       AND (tm.ds_key LIKE 'ch\\_%' ESCAPE '\\' OR tm.ds_key LIKE 'ca\\_%' ESCAPE '\\'))
   SELECT CASE WHEN ch.mdl_seq = {MDL_WHALE} THEN 'right_whale' ELSE 'turtle' END AS grp,
          count(*) AS n_ch,
          count(*) FILTER (WHERE n.value IS NULL)                    AS n_lost,
          count(*) FILTER (WHERE n.value IS DISTINCT FROM o.value)   AS n_changed
   FROM ch
   LEFT JOIN model_cell      n ON n.mdl_seq = ch.mdl_seq AND n.cell_id = ch.cell_id
   LEFT JOIN prev.model_cell o ON o.mdl_seq = ch.mdl_seq AND o.cell_id = ch.cell_id
   GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1"))

d_typ <- dbGetQuery(con,
  "SELECT (SELECT column_type FROM (DESCRIBE SELECT * FROM model_cell)  WHERE column_name = 'value') AS mc_type,
          (SELECT column_type FROM (DESCRIBE SELECT * FROM cell_metric) WHERE column_name = 'value') AS cm_type")

# cells per (model, MAJORITY ecoregion), v7 vs v7c -- the unit the rule is stated in
d_eco <- dbGetQuery(con, glue(
  "WITH n AS (SELECT mdl_seq, zone_key, count(*) AS n FROM model_cell
              JOIN cell_zone USING (cell_id) WHERE mdl_seq IN ({mdl_all_sql}) GROUP BY ALL),
        o AS (SELECT mdl_seq, zone_key, count(*) AS n FROM prev.model_cell
              JOIN cell_zone USING (cell_id) WHERE mdl_seq IN ({mdl_all_sql}) GROUP BY ALL)
   SELECT coalesce(n.mdl_seq, o.mdl_seq) AS mdl_seq, coalesce(n.zone_key, o.zone_key) AS ecoregion,
          coalesce(o.n, 0) AS n_prev, coalesce(n.n, 0) AS n_new
   FROM n FULL JOIN o ON n.mdl_seq = o.mdl_seq AND n.zone_key = o.zone_key
   ORDER BY 2, 1")) |>
  mutate(mdl_seq = as.integer(mdl_seq))

ex_applied <- bind_rows(
  d_excl |> filter(EXCLUDE_TURTLES,     mdl_seq %in% MDL_TURTLE),
  d_excl |> filter(EXCLUDE_RIGHT_WHALE, mdl_seq == MDL_WHALE)) |>
  select(mdl_seq, ecoregion = zone_key, n_cells_v7)
d_eco_chk <- d_eco |>
  left_join(ex_applied, by = c("mdl_seq", "ecoregion")) |>
  mutate(expected = n_prev - coalesce(n_cells_v7, 0L))
d_goa   <- d_eco |> filter(mdl_seq %in% MDL_TURTLE, ecoregion == "GOA", n_prev > 0 | n_new > 0)
d_rw    <- d_eco |> filter(mdl_seq == MDL_WHALE)
rw_n    <- \(e, col) sum(d_rw[[col]][d_rw$ecoregion %in% e])

stopifnot(
  "mdl_seq 54238-54243 must be the six merged turtles, unchanged" =
    identical(as.integer(MDL_TURTLE), MDL_TURTLE_V7),
  "the right whale must keep mdl_seq 54252" =
    nrow(dbGetQuery(con, glue("SELECT 1 FROM taxon WHERE mdl_seq = {MDL_WHALE}
                               AND common_name = 'North Atlantic Right Whale'"))) == 1,
  "model_cell.value must stay INTEGER and cell_metric.value DOUBLE (DuckDB hash() is type-sensitive)" =
    d_typ$mc_type == "INTEGER" && d_typ$cm_type == "DOUBLE",
  "critical habitat was trimmed -- every v7 CH cell of the turtles and the right whale must survive with its v7 value" =
    nrow(n_ch) == 2 && all(n_ch$n_ch > 0) && all(n_ch$n_lost == 0) && all(n_ch$n_changed == 0),
  "v7c: the turtle models must lose exactly the applied exclusions and gain none" =
    gv$turtle_n == N_TURTLE_V7 - n_t && gv$turtle_diff == n_t && gv$turtle_gained == 0,
  "v7c: the right whale must lose exactly the applied exclusions and gain none" =
    gv$whale_n == N_WHALE_V7 - n_w && gv$whale_diff == n_w && gv$whale_gained == 0,
  "v7c: only turtle, mammal, score and _coverage keys may move" =
    ok_release(keys_of(gv$cell_moved)) && ok_release(keys_of(gv$zone_moved)) &&
      all(keys_of(gv$ztx_moved) %in% c("turtle", "mammal")),
  "every (model, majority ecoregion) must hold v7's cells minus exactly the applied exclusion" =
    all(d_eco_chk$n_new == d_eco_chk$expected),
  "no turtle cell may remain in the East Bering Sea, Chukchi/Beaufort Sea or High Arctic ecoregions" =
    !EXCLUDE_TURTLES ||
      !any(d_eco$mdl_seq %in% MDL_TURTLE & d_eco$ecoregion %in% c("EBS", "CBS", "HAR") & d_eco$n_new > 0),
  "the Gulf of Alaska ecoregion must hold exactly v7's four turtles at v7's cell counts" =
    setequal(d_goa$mdl_seq, c(54238L, 54239L, 54241L, 54243L)) && all(d_goa$n_new == d_goa$n_prev),
  "the right whale must hold no cell in the Gulf of America ecoregions (EGOA, WCGOA)" =
    !EXCLUDE_RIGHT_WHALE || rw_n(c("EGOA", "WCGOA"), "n_new") == 0,
  "the right whale must keep v7's Northeast and Southeast Continental Shelf cells" =
    rw_n("NECS", "n_new") == rw_n("NECS", "n_prev") && rw_n("SECS", "n_new") == rw_n("SECS", "n_prev"))
log_info("GATE surface: CH turtle {n_ch$n_ch[n_ch$grp == 'turtle']} / right whale ",
         "{n_ch$n_ch[n_ch$grp == 'right_whale']} cells, 0 lost / 0 changed; types {d_typ$mc_type}/",
         "{d_typ$cm_type}; v7c turtles {gv$turtle_n} (-{gv$turtle_diff}), right whale {gv$whale_n} ",
         "(-{gv$whale_diff}), gained 0; GOA {paste(glue('{d_goa$mdl_seq}={d_goa$n_new}'), collapse = ' ')}; ",
         "right whale EGOA+WCGOA {rw_n(c('EGOA', 'WCGOA'), 'n_new')}, NECS {rw_n('NECS', 'n_new')}, ",
         "SECS {rw_n('SECS', 'n_new')}")

msens::report_table(
  d_eco |>
    left_join(dbGetQuery(con, glue(
      "SELECT mdl_seq, common_name FROM taxon WHERE mdl_seq IN ({mdl_all_sql})")) |>
        mutate(mdl_seq = as.integer(mdl_seq)), by = "mdl_seq") |>
    select(ecoregion, species = common_name, mdl_seq, n_prev, n_new) |>
    rename(!!glue("cells_{ver_prev}") := n_prev, !!glue("cells_{ver}") := n_new),
  caption = "Turtle and right whale cells by majority ecoregion (EBS for the turtles, EGOA / WCGOA for the right whale must be gone)")
```

## Report

### Attribution: what each flag moves, per Program Area

The composite per Program Area under each run, v7.1 (`v7b`, read-only from its own release
database when present) beside it. There is no emulated expectation for v7.2 — the deltas are
printed, and a Program Area whose composite moves by more than 5 points is flagged.

```{r}
#| label: tbl_attribution

lvl <- c(ver_prev, "all_off", "turtles_only", "whale_only", "kappa_only", ver)
d_w <- d_attr |>
  filter(run %in% lvl) |>
  mutate(run = factor(run, levels = lvl)) |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = run, values_from = value) |>
  arrange(what, programarea_key)

# v7.1 beside it: its own release database, read-only, if this machine has it
sdm_db_v7b <- path.expand(msens::sdm_db_path("v7b"))
if (file_exists(sdm_db_v7b)) {
  if (!nrow(dbGetQuery(con, "SELECT 1 FROM duckdb_databases() WHERE database_name = 'v7b'")))
    dbExecute(con, glue("ATTACH '{sdm_db_v7b}' AS v7b (READ_ONLY)"))
  d_v7b <- dbGetQuery(con, glue(
    "SELECT z.value AS programarea_key, m.metric_key, zm.value AS v7b
     FROM v7b.zone_metric zm JOIN v7b.zone z USING (zone_seq) JOIN v7b.metric m USING (metric_seq)
     WHERE z.fld = 'programarea_key'
       AND m.metric_key IN ('extrisk_turtle_ecoregion_rescaled', 'extrisk_mammal_ecoregion_rescaled', '{K_SCORE}')")) |>
    mutate(what = case_when(
      metric_key == K_SCORE ~ "composite",
      str_detect(metric_key, "turtle") ~ "turtle",
      TRUE ~ "mammal")) |>
    select(programarea_key, what, v7b)
  d_w <- d_w |> left_join(d_v7b, by = c("programarea_key", "what"))
} else {
  log_info("v7b release database not on this machine ({sdm_db_v7b}) -- v7.1 column omitted")
}

rank_of <- function(x) rank(-x, na.last = "keep", ties.method = "min")
d_comp <- d_w |> filter(what == "composite") |>
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), \(x) round(x, 1)))
d_turt <- d_w |> filter(what == "turtle") |>
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), \(x) round(x, 1)))
d_mamm <- d_w |> filter(what == "mammal") |>
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), \(x) round(x, 1)))

d_rank <- d_comp |>
  select(-what) |>
  mutate(
    d_v7c    = round(.data[[ver]] - .data[[ver_prev]], 1),
    rank_v7  = rank_of(.data[[ver_prev]]),
    rank_v7c = rank_of(.data[[ver]]),
    flag     = if_else(abs(coalesce(d_v7c, 0)) > 5, "MOVED > 5", ""))
if ("v7b" %in% names(d_rank)) d_rank <- d_rank |> mutate(rank_v7b = rank_of(v7b))
msens::report_table(d_rank,
  caption = "Composite score per Program Area: v7 | controls | v7.2, v7.1 beside it, with ranks")
msens::report_table(d_turt |> select(-what),
  caption = "Turtle component per Program Area (blank = not reportable / no cells)")
msens::report_table(d_mamm |> select(-what),
  caption = "Mammal component per Program Area")

sp <- suppressWarnings(cor(d_comp[[ver_prev]], d_comp[[ver]], method = "spearman", use = "complete.obs"))
log_info("Spearman rank correlation of the composite, {ver_prev} vs {ver}: {round(sp, 4)}")
if ("v7b" %in% names(d_comp)) {
  sp_b <- suppressWarnings(cor(d_comp$v7b, d_comp[[ver]], method = "spearman", use = "complete.obs"))
  log_info("Spearman rank correlation of the composite, v7b vs {ver}: {round(sp_b, 4)}")
}
d_rk <- d_rank |> filter(rank_v7 != rank_v7c)
log_info("ranks changed {ver_prev} -> {ver}: ",
         "{if (nrow(d_rk)) paste(glue('{d_rk$programarea_key} {d_rk$rank_v7}->{d_rk$rank_v7c}'), collapse = ', ') else 'none'}")
if (any(d_rank$flag != ""))
  log_warn("Program Areas whose composite moved > 5: ",
           "{paste(d_rank$programarea_key[d_rank$flag != ''], collapse = ', ')}")
```

### US-EEZ location quotient — diagnostic only

Tim's national reading: turtle weight per km², with **100 = the study-area average**. It is printed
here as a diagnostic, not published — the released metric is v10's distribution share.

```{r}
#| label: tbl_lq

lq_sql <- function(src) glue(
  "WITH t AS (SELECT cell_id, sum(value) AS v FROM {src} WHERE mdl_seq IN ({mdl_sql}) GROUP BY 1),
        nat AS (SELECT sum(t.v * c.area_km2) / sum(c.area_km2) AS m
                FROM cell c LEFT JOIN t USING (cell_id))
   SELECT z.value AS programarea_key,
          sum(coalesce(t.v, 0) * c.area_km2 * zc.pct_covered / 100.0) /
          sum(c.area_km2 * zc.pct_covered / 100.0) / (SELECT m FROM nat) * 100 AS lq,
          sum(coalesce(t.v, 0) * c.area_km2 * zc.pct_covered / 100.0) /
          (SELECT sum(coalesce(t.v, 0) * c.area_km2) FROM cell c LEFT JOIN t USING (cell_id)) * 100 AS pct_us
   FROM zone z JOIN zone_cell zc USING (zone_seq) JOIN cell c ON c.cell_id = zc.cell_id
   LEFT JOIN t ON t.cell_id = zc.cell_id
   WHERE z.fld = 'programarea_key' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY lq DESC")

d_lq <- dbGetQuery(con, lq_sql("prev.model_cell")) |>
  rename(lq_v7 = lq, pct_us_v7 = pct_us) |>
  full_join(dbGetQuery(con, lq_sql("model_cell")) |>
              rename(lq_v7c = lq, pct_us_v7c = pct_us), by = "programarea_key") |>
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), \(x) round(x, 1))) |>
  arrange(desc(lq_v7))
msens::report_table(d_lq, caption = "Turtle location quotient (100 = study-area average per km2) and share of US turtle weight")

ak <- c("ALA", "BOW", "CHU", "COK", "GEO", "GOA", "HOP", "KOD", "NAV", "NOR", "SHU", "MAT")
log_info("Alaska Program Areas hold {round(sum(d_lq$pct_us_v7[d_lq$programarea_key %in% ak], na.rm = TRUE), 2)}% ",
         "of US turtle weight in {ver_prev}, {round(sum(d_lq$pct_us_v7c[d_lq$programarea_key %in% ak], na.rm = TRUE), 2)}% in {ver}")
```

## Manifest

Digests of the surfaces P4 must reproduce on the server: the six turtle models, the right whale,
`cell_metric`, `zone_metric` and `zone_taxon`. `msens::hash_query()` is an order-independent
reduction (`count + bit_xor + sum`), so it does not care how DuckDB partitioned the scan.

It DOES care about the last bit of a DOUBLE, and @sec-compare measured that the zone sums are
not bit-reproducible (parallel `SUM()` reassociates; ~5 ULP). A digest of the raw doubles would
therefore differ between two correct builds, and the server-equals-laptop gate would be red for
no reason. So the INTEGER model surfaces are digested as they are (exact), and every DOUBLE is
digested as `CAST(... AS FLOAT)`: ~7 significant digits at every magnitude (`area_km2` runs to
1e6, a score to 100), nine orders coarser than the noise and far finer than anything either
rule moves.

**The committed manifest is the reference.** A build with the same flags on any machine must
reproduce its digests, and this chunk stops if it does not -- that is P4's "server build equals
the laptop's" gate, run by the render itself rather than by eye. A changed evidence table
(`zone_exclusions_hash`) under the same flags moves the digests too, so it also stops here.
`BUILD_REFERENCE=1` is the only way to move the reference, and says so in the log.

```{r}
#| label: manifest

h <- list(
  turtle_models = msens::hash_query(con, glue(
    "SELECT mdl_seq, cell_id, value FROM model_cell WHERE mdl_seq IN ({mdl_sql})")),
  right_whale_model = msens::hash_query(con, glue(
    "SELECT mdl_seq, cell_id, value FROM model_cell WHERE mdl_seq = {MDL_WHALE}")),
  cell_metric = msens::hash_query(con,
    "SELECT m.metric_key, cm.cell_id, CAST(cm.value AS FLOAT) AS value
     FROM cell_metric cm JOIN metric m USING (metric_seq)"),
  zone_metric = msens::hash_query(con,
    "SELECT z.fld, z.value AS zone_value, m.metric_key, CAST(zm.value AS FLOAT) AS value
     FROM zone_metric zm JOIN zone z USING (zone_seq) JOIN metric m USING (metric_seq)"),
  zone_taxon = msens::hash_query(con,
    "SELECT zone_fld, zone_value, mdl_seq, CAST(area_km2 AS FLOAT) AS area_km2,
            CAST(avg_suit AS FLOAT) AS avg_suit, CAST(suit_rl AS FLOAT) AS suit_rl,
            CAST(pct_cat AS FLOAT) AS pct_cat
     FROM zone_taxon"))

# the reference gate: same flags => same digests as the committed manifest ----
f_mfst   <- here(glue("data/manifests/build_{ver}.json"))
ref      <- if (file_exists(f_mfst)) read_json(f_mfst) else NULL
kappa    <- if (is.na(COVERAGE_FLOOR)) 0 else COVERAGE_FLOOR
is_ref   <- nzchar(Sys.getenv("BUILD_REFERENCE"))
same_flags <- !is.null(ref) &&
  isTRUE(ref$exclude_turtles     == EXCLUDE_TURTLES) &&
  isTRUE(ref$exclude_right_whale == EXCLUDE_RIGHT_WHALE) &&
  isTRUE(ref$coverage_floor      == kappa)

d_dig <- tibble(
  surface   = names(h),
  digest    = unlist(h),
  reference = vapply(names(h), \(k) ref[[glue("digest_{k}")]] %||% NA_character_, ""))
if (is_ref || is.null(ref)) {
  log_info("BUILD_REFERENCE / no manifest yet: these digests BECOME the reference")
} else if (!same_flags) {
  log_info("flags differ from the committed manifest's -- a control render, reference not compared")
} else {
  stopifnot("this build's digests differ from the committed reference (data/manifests); a correct build with the same flags reproduces them on any machine" =
    all(d_dig$digest == d_dig$reference))
  log_info("GATE reference digests reproduced: {paste(d_dig$surface, collapse = ', ')}")
}

gv <- d_gates |> filter(run == ver)
ga <- d_gates |> filter(run == "all_off")

# a control render (flags differ) never overwrites the reference it was not compared against
if (is_ref || is.null(ref) || same_flags) msens::write_manifest(
  f_mfst,
  target       = glue("build_{ver}"),
  content_hash = msens::hash_query(con, glue(
    "SELECT '{h$turtle_models}' AS a, '{h$right_whale_model}' AS b, '{h$cell_metric}' AS c,
            '{h$zone_metric}' AS d, '{h$zone_taxon}' AS e")),
  stats = list(
    ver                       = ver,
    ver_prev                  = ver_prev,
    exclude_turtles           = EXCLUDE_TURTLES,
    exclude_right_whale       = EXCLUDE_RIGHT_WHALE,
    coverage_floor            = kappa,
    zone_exclusions_hash      = EXCL_HASH,
    n_zone_exclusions         = nrow(d_excl),
    digest_turtle_models      = h$turtle_models,
    digest_right_whale_model  = h$right_whale_model,
    digest_cell_metric        = h$cell_metric,
    digest_zone_metric        = h$zone_metric,
    digest_zone_taxon         = h$zone_taxon,
    n_turtle_cells            = gv$turtle_n,
    n_turtle_cells_prev       = ga$turtle_n,
    n_turtle_gained           = gv$turtle_gained,
    n_right_whale_cells       = gv$whale_n,
    n_right_whale_cells_prev  = ga$whale_n,
    n_right_whale_gained      = gv$whale_gained,
    allflagsoff_diffs         = ga$turtle_diff + ga$whale_diff,
    n_ch_cells_turtle         = n_ch$n_ch[n_ch$grp == "turtle"],
    n_ch_cells_right_whale    = n_ch$n_ch[n_ch$grp == "right_whale"],
    n_ch_lost                 = sum(n_ch$n_lost),
    goa_ecoregion_cells       = sum(d_goa$n_new),
    n_not_reportable          = sum(!d_cov$reportable),
    spearman_composite        = round(sp, 4)),
  force = msens::force_target(glue("build_{ver}")))

msens::report_table(d_dig,
  caption = "Content digests (DOUBLEs as FLOAT) vs the committed reference any same-flag build must reproduce")

dbDisconnect(con, shutdown = TRUE)
```
